sql: with legs as ( select lo.market_ticker t, lo.side, lo.limit_price p, lo.quantity q, lo.created_at c0, least(lo.created_at + interval '4 hours', coalesce((select min(f.filled_at) from fills f where f.kalshi_order_id = lo.kalshi_order_id), 'infinity'::timestamptz)) c1 from live_orders lo where lo.strategy='Alimm1' and lo.created_at > '2026-09-25 19:12' and lo.client_order_id not like 'limmexit%' and lo.action='buy'), prog as ( select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, period_reward_usd::float r, extract(epoch from end_date - start_date) secs, discount_factor_bps/10000.0 d, target_size::float tg from incentive_programs order by market_ticker, id desc), snap as ( select s.id, s.market_ticker, s.at, coalesce(s.est_yes_meets_target,false) and coalesce(s.est_no_meets_target,false) qual, s.est_yes_score_total yf, s.est_no_score_total nf, s.yes_levels_json::jsonb yl, s.no_levels_json::jsonb nl, least(300, coalesce(extract(epoch from s.at - lag(s.at) over (partition by s.market_ticker order by s.at)), 72)) dt from incentive_market_snapshots s where s.at > '2026-09-25 19:00' and s.market_ticker in (select t from legs)), x as ( select l.t, l.side, l.p, l.q, sn.qual, sn.dt, pr.r, pr.secs, pr.d, case when l.side='yes' then sn.yf else sn.nf end field, (select z.price from (select (e->>0)::int price, sum((e->>1)::float) over (order by (e->>0)::int desc) cum from jsonb_array_elements(case when l.side='yes' then sn.yl else sn.nl end) e) z where z.cum >= pr.tg/5 order by z.price desc limit 1) refp from legs l join snap sn on sn.market_ticker=l.t and sn.at between l.c0 and l.c1 join prog pr on pr.market_ticker=l.t), y as ( select t, side, p, q, qual, dt, field, refp, case when refp is null then 0 when p >= refp then 1 else power(d, refp - p) end mult, r, secs from x) select t, side, p, q, count(*) snaps, round(sum(dt)/3600.0,1) hrs, round(avg(case when qual then 1 else 0 end)*100) pct_qual, round(avg(refp)) avg_ref, round(avg(mult)::numeric,4) avg_mult, round(avg(case when field>0 then q*mult/field else 0 end)::numeric*100,3) avg_share_pct, round(sum(case when qual and field>0 then r/secs * (q*mult/field)/2 * dt else 0 end)::numeric,4) est_usd from y group by t, side, p, q order by t, side
